values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register 2-9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident and the 1-night reservation minimum (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 season May 14 - Oct 10 (matches; DEC 2026 May 15 - Oct 12), ReserveAmerica 9-month window and 14-night max (DEC row, now on the entry). Added 135 sites to 30 ft, no electric, flush toilets, showers, dump, water. AWH note kept (it is reviewers' opinion; the pages neither confirm nor contradict it).
